signal_policy: The version-2 composite score, factor definitions, universe, and return labels are unchanged.

locked_construction.risk_scaling: inverse trailing 24-month volatility, requiring 18 months and clipping volatility at the monthly 10th/90th percentiles
locked_construction.constraints: dollar, rolling-market-beta, SIC-sector, and log-market-cap neutral projection
locked_construction.turnover_control: rebalance 35% of desired change; ignore absolute target changes below 0.0005
locked_construction.volatility_target: 10% annualized from the preceding 24 portfolio returns, requiring 12 months, with 0.5x to 1.5x multiplier

acceptance_gates: average monthly turnover is lower than the frozen baseline
maximum drawdown is no worse than the frozen baseline
paired 12-month moving-block 95% interval for the Sharpe improvement excludes zero
mean absolute rolling-beta exposure is below 0.05
claim_policy: Even if every retrospective gate passes, the result is an engineering improvement, not validated alpha. Prospective status remains NOT_STARTED and the future-only 36-month rule is unchanged.
